name: Goliath frog
desc: The largest frog in the world; it lives in fast rivers in the southern part of the park and is protected from hunting. It eats insects and other small animals.
about: The goliath frog, otherwise known commonly as the giant slippery frog and the goliath bullfrog, is a species of frog in the family Conrauidae. The goliath frog is the largest living frog.
